notes: «حدثنا أو، سمعت جابر» : the name before «سمعت» is cut to «أو» in the text; read as an unnamed gap, not completed
«تابعه قتيبة» after the saying is a second isnad carrying the same saying: second group
«وأثنى عليه» is an editor's remark, left out

fixes.reason: the transmitter between Sa'id b. Mina and Jabir is written only as «أو», a cut-off name

evidence.quote: حدثنا أو، سمعت جابر بن عبد الله
